plain_text:
Howard McNear appears in 648 recordings across 37 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1937 to 1961. The credits here include performer and commercial spokesman.

In this archive, you will hear Howard McNear most often in Gunsmoke, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, The Line Up, Lux Radio Theatre, Broadway Is My Beat, Wild Bill Hickok, The Six Shooter, and The Adventures of Philip Marlowe.

Characters credited here include Doc Adams and Pliny.
